text:
maria: Quick sync — we need to finalize the Cloud Store launch playbook (GCP + Azure + HPE hardware bundle + SI integrations). Targeting next Mon launch. Who can own press, blog, landing page, partner assets, and timeline?

alex: I can drive the landing page + tracking. Need hero copy and partner-approved logos.

samir: PR will prep an embargoed release. Need partner quotes by EOD Fri. @olivia can you chase quotes and approvals?

olivia: On it. Draft blog outline by tomorrow morning. Also proposing a joint webinar week-of-launch + a partner case study.

maria: Proposed timeline: Tue (dry run): final assets in staging; Wed: legal + partner approvals; Thu: embargo shared with partners; Mon (09:00 PT): publish blog + press + landing + webinar signup opens. Thoughts?

alex: Sounds good. Two asks: 1) confirm GA pricing snippet for the landing page, 2) give me final high-res logos by Fri noon. Also will add utm params: `utm_source=cloudstore_partner&utm_medium=co-marketing`.

pressbot: PR draft created: /docs/press/cloudstore-launch-draft-v1.md — shared with @samir and team.

samir: Thanks. I’ll add partner quotes and send to partners for review by Fri 5pm PST. If no reply, we’ll fall back to approved boilerplate quote.

olivia: Landing page checklist (baseline):
```
- hero + concise subhead
- 3 partner logos (high-res SVG/PNG)
- 'How it works' 3-step diagram + SVG
- pricing snippet + FAQ link
- CTA: Request demo + Start free trial
- SEO meta (title, description, og:image)
- analytics events + pixel
```

alex: Also add telemetry event names: `cloudstore_launch_view`, `cloudstore_cta_click`, `cloudstore_signup`. I'll wire them to tracking-service in staging.

maria: HPE needs a SKU mapping CSV and co-marketing copy for the bundle page. @alex can you drop into the assets bucket at s3://redwood-partners/hpe-cloudstore/ ? Use folder `assets/for-partners/`.

alex: Uploaded placeholder SVGs, pricing table CSV, and a draft SKU mapping to s3. Will swap with final logos when received.

olivia: Blog outline: 1) Customer problem 2) How Redwood solves it 3) Partner benefits & hardware + SI flow 4) How to get started (links to marketplace + docs) 5) Partner quotes + CTA. I’ll share a draft link in #docs later today.

samir: Comms ask: set embargo time at 09:00 PT on launch day. Partners must confirm. Any objections?

maria: No objections — embargo set 09:00 PT. I’ll send calendar invite for Tue dry run at 10:00 PT (staging walkthrough).

alex: Dry run ok from my side. I’ll test landing build, redirects, and telemetry in staging during the walk-through.

olivia: Can someone own partner webinar slides? I can draft the deck, but need a co-presenter from HPE and an SI PO.

maria: I’ll loop HPE PM and the SI lead for speaker confirmations. @olivia please prepare the slide baseline and slide notes.

pressbot: Reminder: legal must review partner quotes for trademark usage — please file ticket #PR-789 and tag legal.

samir: Opening ticket #PR-789 now and tagging legal/compliance. Will update thread when cleared.

maria: Final checklist before Tue dry run: 1) partner logos 2) partner quotes approved 3) landing page build in staging 4) PR draft ready + embargo list 5) webinar speaker confirmed 6) telemetry wired and smoke-tested. Ping here if blocked.

alex: Quick note — confirm CDN purge plan for launch so we can post updates quickly if partner assets change.

maria: Good call. @eng-infra (we'll loop them) — prepare CDN purge playbook for Monday 08:50 PT in case we need same-day fixes.

olivia: Will also prepare a short social plan + suggested copy for partner channels. Drop in this thread when done.

samir: I'll schedule a brief pre-launch standup Mon 08:30 PT for final go/no-go.

maria: Perfect — thanks all. If anyone is blocked getting logos/quotes, tell me asap and I’ll escalate to partner PMs.
